MGIMS participated in the Amrut Mahotsav
Tuesday, 01 June 2021
3961 Hits
MGIMS participated in the Amrut Mahotsav (Azadi ka अमृत महोत्सव) - a GOI initiative to commemorate the 75th Anniversary of Indian Independence - from 15th to 31st May 2021. During the fortnight, MGIMS hosted a series of activities and promoted the Prime Minister's vision of resurgent and Aatmanirbhar Bharat.
Amrut Mahotsav Report
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
